Trump Bans CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from White House

President Donald Trump announced on Tuesday that he is banning CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from the White House. Trump accused the outlets of reporting "fake news." The action, described as unprecedented by some outlets, raises concerns about further insulating the president from direct critical questioning. The ban applies to covering the White House.
